name: Moon Fleet Guest House
suitableFor: Couples, small groups and dog owners
beachAccess: About 300 yards from the sea near Cattersty Sands and Skinningrove
confirmedFeatures: Private bar, games room, breakfast room, facilities for muddy paws
overview: A guest house just down the coast from Saltburn, about 300 yards from the sea near Cattersty Sands and Skinningrove. It has six en-suite rooms, a private bar and games room, and free parking. Saltburn's beach is a short drive back up the coast.
surfTripFit: Free parking and a short drive to Saltburn suit surfers who want a quieter base nearby.
